title: Air volume demonstration for children
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vh5e386
materials: Crumple a piece of napkin or paper towel.

steps.title: Fill bowl with water
steps.instruction: Take a large bowl and fill it with water almost to the top.

steps.title: Select dry cup
steps.instruction: Obtain a dry cup that can fully fit inside the bowl.

steps.title: Add tape to cup
steps.instruction: Apply double‑sided or rolled tape to the bottom of the cup so both sides are sticky.

steps.title: Place paper towel in cup
steps.instruction: Insert a paper towel into the cup, attaching it to the taped bottom; ensure the towel is fully inside and away from the open edge.

steps.title: Submerge cup face down
steps.instruction: Carefully push the cup, face down, into the bowl without tilting, then continue submerging until water covers the top of the cup.

substeps.instruction: Push cup face down into bowl without tilting
Submerge fully so water covers cup top

steps.title: Lift cup and drain
steps.instruction: Carefully lift the cup from the bowl without tilting; once out, tilt it slightly to let water drip off.

steps.title: Remove paper towel
steps.instruction: Using a dry hand, pull the paper towel out of the cup.
